messages:
Nina (AE): Quick ask  Client AuroraPay wants a 2-week POC: semantic search + chat. They estimate ~150k vector lookups/day + ~30k chat turns/day. Need capacity + conservative budget for procurement by EOD.
Sam (Solutions): Clarify numbers: 150k lookups + 30k chats, got it. Any sample prompt sizes?
Nina (AE): Sample: prompt ~300 tokens, reply ~350 tokens, top-4 docs ~200 tokens each. They also warned about nightly sync spikes ~6x for ~20 minutes.
Ivy (ML Eng): Per chat = 300+350+(4*200)=1,650 tokens. 30k chats/day -> ~49.5M gen tokens/day (~700M for 2 weeks). Embed ingest: assume 150k initial docs -> one-time embed compute; lookups are DB ops.
Tom (Infra): Avg rps ~2.0; with 6x spikes -> ~12 rps. For p95 target <=1.5s recommend 2x A10G or 1x A100 equiv with batching and a warm pool. Suggest dedicated POC pool with autoscale min=1 max=3.
Ivy (ML Eng): Cost sketch (examples): Hosted gen tokens 700M * $0.02/1k = ~$14k; embeddings one-time ~$150; vector DB ops ~$1.5k -> hosted ballpark ~$16k + margin. Dedicated short-term (2 weeks) infra ~ $12k-$18k depending on instance type and bandwidth. Recommend quoting Hosted ~$20k, Dedicated ~$16k conservative.
Lina (Security): Client sent vendor questionnaire. Key items: EU data residency, BYOK/KMS, retention & audit logs. If they require Private/VPC, lead time ~4 weeks. For POC we can offer hosted with EU tenancy and limited retention. I'll draft answers.
Sam (Solutions): Proposed POC success criteria for the slide: (1) p95 <=1.5s for 80% traffic, (2) recall@4 >=0.7 on their eval set, (3) ingest >=10k docs/hr, (4) cost within quoted budget.
Nina (AE): Good. Can we get a 1-page runbook + short cost table by tomorrow morning?
Tom (Infra): I'll post a stub runbook (deploy steps, scale knobs, obs queries) and config snippet.
PresalesBot: Created ticket POC-4107 and sent calendar invite for Monday 10:00.
Nina (AE): Thanks everyone  I'll update the client with conservative numbers and security caveats. Update this thread if estimates change.
